Police found a truck that was believed to have fled the scene at a transportation company in the city of Samayura, and they're hearing from the driver.

The prime minister of the city of Hokkaido has said that about 30 percent of the working people in the country have already been paid income support, which he plans to introduce as part of tax cuts.
